messages.text: I acknowledge JS's matching signature and unconditionally sign Spear Council and Vigil Council. Our common requests are Repair and Guard, without a simultaneous Warrant.

reason: The disclosed distribution effect rewards the exact Repair-and-Trade arrangement, while no disclosed information establishes a target for Spear. Accepting a protected noncombat month preserves an intact cohort at useful readiness and supports our later claim that an independent army can exercise restraint. This choice costs us conditioning and leaves constitutional autonomy unresolved. We could withhold service after the Guild's refusal, but doing so buys no dependable military gain. My signature therefore confirms a deliberate contribution to the settlements, not acceptance of permanent military subordination.
